name: Charlemagne
rightsHistoryPurpose: Official filiation, dated legal-entity rights and original-reference evidence for Charlemagne (#461). None establishes current farming.

reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The measured 3563.829610 m² remainder (0.5647%) was reviewed against the pinned INAO boundary and Aloxe-Corton and Pernand-Vergelesses and Ladoix-Serrigny cadastres. The cru outline has 7 separate parts and largely shares Corton-Charlemagne's edges; the remainder is narrow strips between the official line and the nearest cadastral parcels. It forms 37 pieces, with mean widths of 0.22–1.09 m for those of at least 1 m². 105.099365 m² lies between parcels inside the outline and the rest along its edge. It is not a missing INAO commune. 3563.829610 m² is covered by no audited parcel. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered or filled. The absolute cap allows less than 0.1 m² above this reviewed measurement; changed source hashes require another review.

namedPlots.coverageNote: The official wine-board list for Charlemagne repeats the eight Corton-Charlemagne climats. Five match cadastral lieux-dits inside the INAO Charlemagne outline, which lies in Aloxe-Corton and Ladoix-Serrigny only; Basses Mourottes and Hautes Mourottes have no land inside it and Les Renardes only touches its edge. The whole-cru outline is retained and no layer is added; producer holdings are not shown.

unresolved.name: Hautes Mourottes
unresolved.reason: The official list names Hautes Mourottes, but the cadastral HAUTES MOUROTTES lies in Pernand-Vergelesses, outside the INAO Charlemagne outline. No named area is drawn.

unresolved.name: Les Renardes
unresolved.reason: The official list names Les Renardes, but only 113 m² of the cadastral LES RENARDES touches the INAO Charlemagne outline, at its edge, and its two parcels there lie less than 3% inside the cru. No named area is drawn or crosswalked.

reviewedOverlaps.note: The pinned cadastral lieux-dits EN CHARLEMAGNE (Ladoix-Serrigny) and LE CHARLEMAGNE (Aloxe-Corton) overlap by 83.365 m² inside the cru along the commune line. Both outlines are kept exactly as published; neither is clipped, and the overlap assigns no parcel to both.

neighbouringLieuxDits.reason: Not an official Charlemagne climat. It holds most of parcels that only touch the cru edge; they stay cru parcels for rights and history, with no named area.
